usedFor: Adafruit IO logs device data, and Memory stores each “New Feed Data” reading as a key-value pair through “Memory”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feed Data” in Adafruit IO, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: Every new reading is saved under a key, so later workflows can look up the latest value.

watchOut: “New Feed Data” in Adafruit IO is polling, so readings reach Memory after a scheduled check, not at once.
